source_book: Sri Chaitanya — IPE STUDY MATERIAL for Jr. Students, Chemistry (2026-27 edition)
note: Question index for diffing and authoring: VSAQ 23 entries (printed numbers 1–18), SAQ 12 (19–29), LAQ 30 (30–46), PROBLEM 74 (intext 10.1–10.38) — 139 entries in all; numbering runs continuously across the VSAQ/SAQ/LAQ sections, and stems are restated in our own wording with the chemistry kept exact and no solution content, by policy. Scan oddities: the left margin is cropped on several pages (the number of Q17 and the first digit of Q29 are cut off, and a star before Q6 cannot be confirmed), VSAQ 3 = LAQ 45 and SAQ 21 = LAQ 38 word for word, and problem 10.28 is printed as '1028'; drawn structures are described in words with our condensed-formula reading.
